cards.definition: Judging only from successful examples (केवल सफल उदाहरणों से निष्कर्ष निकालना)
cards.exampleSentence: Case studies often suffer from survivorship bias.

cards.definition: A systematic error in thinking (सोचने में व्यवस्थित त्रुटि)
cards.exampleSentence: Cognitive bias affects estimation.

cards.definition: Relying too heavily on the first piece of information (पहली जानकारी पर अधिक निर्भर होना)
cards.exampleSentence: Anchoring on the first quote skewed negotiations.

cards.definition: Poor decision-making due to desire for harmony (एकमत बनाए रखने के दबाव में ग़लत फ़ैसले)
cards.exampleSentence: Groupthink silenced the dissenting engineer.

cards.definition: Presenting two options as the only ones available (केवल दो विकल्प दिखाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Speed versus quality is a false dichotomy.

cards.definition: An argument that a small step leads to extreme results (छोटे कदम से बड़े नतीजे की दलील)
cards.exampleSentence: One exception isn't necessarily a slippery slope.

cards.definition: Misrepresenting someone's argument to attack it easily (विरोधी तर्क को तोड़-मरोड़कर पेश करना)
cards.exampleSentence: That's a straw man; nobody suggested removing tests.

cards.definition: A misleading clue that distracts from the real issue (भटकाने वाला संकेत)
cards.exampleSentence: The memory warning was a red herring.

cards.definition: Created for a specific purpose without general planning (तात्कालिक / विशेष उद्देश्य हेतु)
cards.exampleSentence: Ad hoc fixes make the system harder to maintain.

cards.definition: A practical rule of thumb for problem-solving (अनुभव आधारित व्यावहारिक तरीका)
cards.exampleSentence: We used a simple heuristic to rank incidents.

cards.definition: Breaking problems into clear step-by-step solutions (चरणबद्ध समाधान सोचने की क्षमता)
cards.exampleSentence: Algorithmic thinking improves debugging.

cards.definition: To break a problem into smaller parts (समस्या को छोटे भागों में बाँटना)
cards.exampleSentence: Decompose the task into tickets of one day each.

cards.definition: To hide complexity behind a simpler layer (जटिलता को सरल परत के पीछे छुपाना)
cards.exampleSentence: The library abstracts away the retry logic.

cards.definition: To apply a specific finding more broadly (विशेष निष्कर्ष को व्यापक रूप से लागू करना)
cards.exampleSentence: We can't generalise from one vendor's behaviour.

cards.definition: To make something seem simpler than it is (ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा सरल बना देना)
cards.exampleSentence: Blaming one engineer oversimplifies the incident.

cards.definition: To limit or modify a statement (कथन में शर्त जोड़ना)
cards.exampleSentence: Let me qualify that: it works only for small files.

cards.definition: A statement supported by evidence (प्रमाण से समर्थित दावा)
cards.exampleSentence: Only substantiated claims belong in the report.

cards.definition: Having no basis in fact (निराधार)
cards.exampleSentence: The rumour about data loss was unfounded.

cards.definition: Without evidence or reason (बेबुनियाद)
cards.exampleSentence: The accusation was baseless.

cards.definition: A broad claim made without considering details (बिना बारीकी के व्यापक कथन)
cards.exampleSentence: Saying all vendors are unreliable is a sweeping statement.

cards.definition: A failure to notice or consider something (चूक)
cards.exampleSentence: The missing alert was an oversight.

cards.definition: An area where one lacks awareness (जिस पर ध्यान न जाए वह क्षेत्र)
cards.exampleSentence: Security was a blind spot in our design.

cards.definition: A gap in a rule that allows avoidance (नियम में कमी का छेद)
cards.exampleSentence: The loophole let invalid files pass validation.

cards.definition: Possible dangers and protective measures (ख़तरे और बचाव के उपाय)
cards.exampleSentence: The guide lists pitfalls and safeguards.

cards.definition: Confidential business information (व्यावसायिक गोपनीय जानकारी)
cards.exampleSentence: The contract protects trade secrets.

cards.definition: Acting without certainty about the outcome (अनिश्चितता में भरोसा करके कदम उठाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Adopting the new platform was a leap of faith.

cards.definition: A risk taken after careful thought (सोच-समझकर लिया गया जोखिम)
cards.exampleSentence: Shipping early was a calculated risk.

cards.definition: A second verification (दोबारा जाँच)
cards.exampleSentence: Do a double-check before sending the numbers.

cards.definition: To verify using a different source (दूसरे स्रोत से मिलान करना)
cards.exampleSentence: Cross-check the totals with the vendor report.

cards.definition: To compare performance with a standard (मानक से तुलना करना)
cards.exampleSentence: We benchmarked the new parser against the old one.

cards.definition: To test under extreme conditions (चरम स्थितियों में परखना)
cards.exampleSentence: We stress-tested the platform with ten times the volume.

cards.definition: To quickly verify that a result is reasonable (तर्कसंगतता जाँचना)
cards.exampleSentence: Sanity-check the report totals before sharing.

cards.definition: A discussion after an event to review what happened (घटना के बाद की समीक्षा चर्चा)
cards.exampleSentence: We held a debrief after the release.

cards.definition: Insights gained from experience (अनुभव से मिली सीख)
cards.exampleSentence: Capture lessons learned in the postmortem.

cards.definition: Information held by long-term employees (संस्था में दीर्घकालिक अनुभव से बना ज्ञान)
cards.exampleSentence: Institutional knowledge leaves when seniors resign.
